reviewer_method: Single agent manual semantic review of every sample before new model inference; NOT independent human adjudication. Human sign-off pending. No thresholds, rules, taxonomies or weights tuned.
known_limitations: Small synthetic English set; not representative real-world news
One agent reviewer; independent human sign-off pending; no inter-annotator agreement
Ambiguous institutional/location names, sentiment intentions, overlapping topic labels and missing cultural event subtype
Coarse one-partner retrieval judgments are incomplete
Candidate resolution is a tiny supplied-candidate task, not global linking
